events.notes: CG-16/CG-18 (Cognition keeper 2026-11-01; agreed by Reality, Life, Economy and Settlement). One outcome type for every action kind; cause = the intention event id; status completed | failed | impossible (C-Q25: whether a refusal is failed, Rex). Produced by the engine resolving the action kind (shared.action.resolution); consumed through the host's outcome command. stimuli are raw scene truth records; their element schema is not yet fixed (no 3007 kind fits a record), so 'of' is omitted. payload? carries the engine-native record (trade, refused, contact_event) and is not typed here.

IF-27 (Settlement keeper 2026-11-01): native event emitted by hire beside shared.action.outcome; cause is the intention event id when hire was asked for by an intention. Consumers to be named by Settlement.
